parameters.negative_prompt: news broadcast, stock footage, advertisement, 3d animation, computer graphics, cartoon, watermark, logo, text, on screen text, subtitles, titles, signature, slow motion, dramatic reaction, handshake, contract signing, celebration, distorted face, distorted hands, extra fingers

response.prompt: Continue this exact two-person scene for five seconds as a restrained observational documentary insert. Preserve the same older woman owner at frame left, the same younger male buyer at frame right, their faces, clothing, hands, mug, blank notebook, worn table, workshop, and late-afternoon light. Neither person speaks or reaches across the table. Keep both sets of hands on their own side in their existing resting poses. Use only subtle natural breathing and blinking; the buyer briefly lowers his eyes toward the blank notebook while the owner remains calmly attentive. Make one very slow, steady lateral camera slide to the left and a slight focus shift from the notebook to the owner. No new person enters. Keep faces, fingers, clothing, furniture, windows, and room geometry stable and realistic. No writing appears. Quiet documentary film, not an advertisement.
